description.value: Built in 1928 and listed as a heritage property, The Plaza Hotel anchors downtown Kamloops with renovated rooms that blend preserved historic character with modern comforts. It operates an explicitly cyclist-focused program, offering a locked interior bike storage room, a dedicated bike cleaning station, and a biking-specific room rate. An on-site restaurant featuring locally-raised steak, complimentary hot buffet breakfast, and complimentary YMCA access make it a well-rounded base for multi-day touring.
